action.query: SiriusXM free trial satellite radio official
queries: SiriusXM free trial satellite radio official
free satellite radio legality SiriusXM alternatives

content.text:
If you mean **free SiriusXM / satellite radio**, the legit options are:

1. **SiriusXM Free Access plan** — SiriusXM currently offers an **ad-supported Free Access** streaming plan with select channels/content. ([siriusxm.com](https://www.siriusxm.com/plans/free-access?utm_source=openai))  
2. **SiriusXM free trial** — You can try SiriusXM for free, often for streaming and/or eligible car radios. Check the official trial page. ([siriusxm.com](https://www.siriusxm.com/free-trial?utm_source=openai))  
3. **New/used car trial** — Many vehicles with SiriusXM built in come with a free trial; you may need your **Radio ID/ESN** to activate or refresh the signal. ([siriusxm.com](https://www.siriusxm.com/trial-benefits-2?utm_source=openai))  
4. **Free listening events** — SiriusXM sometimes turns on inactive car radios for limited “Listen Free” events, but these are temporary.

If you want **actually free radio without a subscription**, use:
- **AM/FM radio** in the car
- **iHeartRadio**, **TuneIn**, **Audacy**, or local station apps
- **YouTube Music / Spotify free tiers** for music, though they’re not satellite radio

Avoid “free SiriusXM hack” devices/apps—SiriusXM satellite service is subscription-based, and bypassing activation isn’t legal.
